turns.text: White privilege refers to the unearned advantages that individuals benefit from simply based on their racial identity, often without being aware of it. In my teaching, I aim to explain these concepts clearly and objectively, using examples and encouraging open, respectful dialogue. It’s important to approach these discussions with sensitivity and a willingness to learn from different perspectives.
